question: The idea of Rule of Law was adopted from the Constitution of which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rule of law plays an important role in the administration of the country.
 
• It protects against the arbitrary actions of the administrative authorities.
 
• It helps to maintain public order by compelling individuals to behave in a legal manner.
 
• It also safeguards the individual by defining the powers of the government.
 
• The rules and regulations laid out by the **government are equal for all the citizens of the country**.
 
• No one is treated with extra perks and benefits under the law.
 
• It also prevents one section of society from dominating the other.
 
• It is adapted from the United Kingdom constitution.
 
• Other influences of the British Constitution are the **Parliamentary form of government, The idea of single citizenship, the Law making procedure, and The institution of the speaker**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** United States Constitution
